senses.gloss: m. (פטם to break, cmp. Arab. faṭas mortuus fuit) slain body, corpse.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> top <he>חמי לי פִּטּוּמֵיה</he> show me his (Bar Kokhba’s) body; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 946:2">Yalk. Deut. 946</cite> <he>אייתון לי גופיה פטומיא</he> (read: <he>אייתון לי פטומיה</he>, <he>גופיה</he> being a gloss to <he>פ׳</he>).—Pl. <cite ref="Q00623"><he>פִּיטּוּמִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00616"><he>פִּטּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>זיל אייתי לי פִּיטּוּמַיְהוּ</he> go and bring me their bodies
